subject: MAP: GPU allocation triage & SOC2 gating
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Diana Morales <diana@helixai.com>, HelixAI Ops <ops@helixai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T16:12:00Z
Subject: MAP: GPU allocation triage & SOC2 gating

Diana, thanks again for the demo today — appreciate the candid discussion about model latency targets and your SOC2 timeline. Per our conversation, I sketched a short mutual action plan so we can align procurement windows with your security gate. Key asks below: 

- Redwood: provide a scoping + GPU sizing estimate for the eval (N1).
- HelixAI: confirm SOC2 controls milestone (target: report issued by end of Q4).
- Joint: agree on an acceptance window for private deployment (2-phase: pilot -> production).

I've attached a quick sizing estimate (gpu-sizing-estimate.csv) and a rough MAP timeline (MAP_timeline_v1.pdf). Karthik/Marissa — can you weigh in on realistic lead times for Dedicated tranches (NVIDIA A100 -> Ampere/next-gen fallback) and a recommended holdback policy if SOC2 slips?

Attachments: MAP_timeline_v1.pdf (draft), gpu-sizing-estimate.csv

Thanks,
Marcus
VP, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Diana Morales <diana@helixai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: HelixAI Ops <ops@helixai.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T19:03:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP: GPU allocation triage & SOC2 gating

Marcus — thanks for pulling this together. Quick answers from our side: 

- SOC2: We have an external firm scheduled for fieldwork starting 2026-10-04. Target is Type II report by 2026-12-15 but there is some risk (~2–3 weeks) depending on evidence turnaround.
- Eval cadence: we can commit to a 4-week eval starting 2026-09-20 if provisioning is ready. Pilot -> Prod handover could be as early as mid-November if SOC2 completes on time.

We'll attach the internal control matrix for visibility (sending offline to ops@helixai.com). Please confirm what evidence Redwood needs for the private deployment acceptance checklist so we can surface it to security.

Best,
Diana Morales
Head of Partnerships, HelixAI
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Diana Morales <diana@helixai.com>, HelixAI Ops <ops@helixai.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T02:14:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP: GPU allocation triage & SOC2 gating

Thanks — a few practical notes from the infra/procurement side: 

1) Lead times: for Dedicated A100 tranches we should assume 10–12 weeks from PO to capacity in our standard regions today. If HelixAI needs a private VPC on-prem pattern, add another 3–4 weeks for networking and validation.

2) Sizing sanity-check: I reviewed your model profile (latency ~120ms p50, batchable workload). The attached csv is conservative: recommend 12 x 80GB GPUs for a 50k daily token workload during eval peak; prod baseline at 36 x 80GB (staggered): 12 pilot / +12 canary / +12 steady. Failover plan: we can route to hosted model variants with a 20% perf delta if private allocation delayed.

3) Acceptance gating: SOC2 Type II should be in place before full production commit. For pilot -> prod move we can accept a signed attestation + SOC2 evidence checklist (minimal) to enable canary tranche if legal approves.

I'll attach a short procurement playbook in the shared drive (link in related_links).

—Karthik
Director, Infrastructure Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Diana Morales <diana@helixai.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-19T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: MAP: GPU allocation triage & SOC2 gating

Folks — proposed mutual action plan (draft) below. I made milestones tight but intentionally left 1 buffer tranche for procurement slips. Please review and call out blockers.

MAP DRAFT (high level):
- Week 0 (2026-08-17): MAP kickoff + control matrix exchange (HelixAI).
- Week 4 (by 2026-09-14): Eval provisioning complete (12 x 80GB on dedicated pool). Redwood to provide performance baseline and run smoke tests.
- Week 6–9 (2026-09-20 to 2026-10-11): 4-week eval window (HelixAI runs workload, Redwood monitors KPIs).
- Week 11 (by 2026-10-26): Pilot acceptance review — security checklist + signed attestation required. If SOC2 fieldwork delayed beyond 2026-10-04, holdback tranche invoked (move to hosted fallback).
- Week 16–20 (by 2026-12-15): Full production tranche rollout contingent on SOC2 Type II. Production sizing initial tranche: +24 GPUs to reach 36 x 80GB; staggered adds every 2 weeks.

Deliverables (Redwood): pricing for tranches, runbook for rollback, canary routing policy.
Deliverables (HelixAI): control evidence, procurement PO by Week 6 if moving to reserve.

Attachments: HelixAI_SOC2_gap.xlsx (control gaps we flagged during intake).

If HelixAI wants to compress timelines we can look at partial staging on Redwood Hosted while private capacity is provisioned; that would remove the single-point risk for service continuity.

Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: MAP: GPU allocation triage & SOC2 gating

Thanks all — this is actionable and aligned. Diana, can you confirm by Friday whether HelixAI will issue a PO for the pilot tranche (12 x 80GB) or prefer hosted fallback? If we get PO by Friday (2026-08-21) we can prioritize the 10–12 week procurement path and hold the pilot start for 2026-09-20.

Next steps:
- HelixAI: confirm PO vs hosted fallback (by 2026-08-21).
- Redwood: finalize pricing and send mutual acceptance checklist (I'll circulate a DocuSign link after Marissa and Karthik confirm the acceptance clause language).

Attaching the three docs referenced in thread.
